titulo.alumno: Novice · Shopping and prices: Guided writing

intro: T1 · Beginner · Recognise letters, vocabulary and common phrases; understand basic grammar structures and short sentences from everyday life. Topic: Shopping and prices. Focus: Lexical and grammar practice.

texto: Guided writing: write a shopping enquiry. Practise writing price questions using the deictics «อันนี้» and «อันนั้น». Structure: [อันนี้ / อันนั้น] + [ราคาเท่าไหร่] + [ครับ / ค่ะ]. Check that the words have their exact tone marks.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «ของฝากและงานหัตถกรรมพื้นบ้านสะท้อนถึงภูมิปัญญาและความประณีตของชุมชน» express?

opciones.texto: Handicrafts and traditional souvenirs reflect the skill of the community.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «ของฝากและงานหัตถกรรมพื้นบ้านสะท้อนถึงภูมิปัญญาและความประณีตของชุมชน» from the text.

opciones.texto: Keeping your receipt is very useful if you need to exchange an item.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the text, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Markets and shopping centres offer a wide selection for every budget.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: Read the sentence and choose its meaning.
